agency: Maryland Department of Housing and Community Development, Maryland Mortgage Program (MMP)

programs.name: MMP 1st Time Advantage 3%, 4% or 5%

amount.text: a DPA loan equal to 3%, 4% or 5% of the first mortgage, depending on the product chosen

programs.repayment: zero percent deferred second lien, due when the first mortgage ends (repayment, refinance, transfer, sale)
programs.firstTimeNote: or one of the exceptions (qualified veterans, targeted areas)

incomeLimit.text: MMP income and purchase price limits by county and household size

programs.quote: 1st Time Advantage 5% Loan Comes with a DPA loan equal to 5% of the first mortgage in a zero percent deferred second lien.

programs.name: MMP 1st Time Advantage 6000

amount.text: a $6,000 loan for down payment and closing costs, plus Partner Match where an approved partner contributes

programs.repayment: zero percent interest, no payments for the life of the first mortgage; due when the first mortgage ends
programs.quote: 1st Time Advantage 6000 Comes with a $6,000 loan for down payment and closing costs. This second lien has a zero percent interest rate, and no payments are due for the life of the first mortgage.

local.name: First Homes for First Responders and Teachers
local.text: 5% of the first mortgage in a zero percent deferred second lien, for first-time buyers employed full time as teachers or by public safety agencies, fire departments, ambulance services or hospitals
